title: Building the Bond and Qudwah with Your Child (Ages 4-6)
description: A 14-day tarbiyah journey that helps the parent build a secure emotional bond with their child in the preoperational stage (Piaget preoperational) through dramatic play, daily dialogue, and short stories, with practical application of the principle of qudwah (role modeling) that begins with the parent themselves.

primary_reference.info: عبد الله ناصح علوان، تربية الأولاد في الإسلام، الجزء الأول — الفصل الثالث (اللعب والرفق)

review_defects.why: The Arabic uses the masculine singular 'الوالد' (the father) and 'نفسه' (himself), but the English uses gender-neutral 'the parent' and 'themselves', losing the specific reference to the father.

The Arabic adjective 'تربوية' (educational/upbringing) is rendered as the noun 'tarbiyah' instead of the correct transliteration 'tarbawiyyah' or a translation like 'educational journey'. This misrepresents the grammatical form and meaning.
